We introduce CL3DOD, a class-incremental 3D detection framework that restores missing supervision for previous classes using predictions from the previous-stage detector, preserves old-class responses through query-wise knowledge distillation, and employs EMA-based temporal consistency regularization. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes reveal a consistent stability-plasticity dilemma across both benchmarks. CL3DOD generally achieves a more favorable stability-plasticity balance than controlled incremental baselines and improves upon published prior methods in the reported benchmark comparisons. This advantage persists across multiple incremental stages, demonstrating strong retention of previously learned knowledge while maintaining effective new-class acquisition. Our code, evaluation setup, and incremental task splits will be publicly released.
summary_zh: 针对户外三维目标检测的类增量学习研究仍 largely 未被充分探索。现有户外研究仅限于单一基准评估，其中SDCoT++考虑KITTI，而CL2OD在nuScenes上采用不同的增量设置。这使得评估所观察到的持续学习行为能否在多个自动驾驶基准间泛化变得困难。据我们所知，我们首次提供了跨多个自动驾驶基准的户外类增量三维目标检测统一跨基准分析，涵盖双任务和多阶段设置。我们研究了：(1)现有三维检测器对先前学习类别的遗忘严重程度；(2)增量训练如何暴露知识保留与新类别获取之间的稳定性-可塑性困境；(3)哪种监督形式在平衡这些目标时最为有效。我们提出了CL3DOD，一种类增量三维检测框架，该框架利用前一阶段检测器的预测来恢复先前类别缺失的监督，通过查询级知识蒸馏保留旧类响应，并采用基于EMA的时间一致性正则化。在KITTI和nuScenes上的实验揭示了两个基准间一致的稳定性-可塑性困境。相较于受控增量基线，CL3DOD通常实现更优的稳定性-可塑性平衡，并在已发表的基准比较中优于先前方法。该优势在多个增量阶段中持续存在，展示了在保持有效新类别获取的同时对先前学习知识的强大保留能力。我们的代码、评估设置和增量任务划分将公开发布。
tldr: This paper presents the first unified cross-benchmark analysis of class-incremental 3D object detection for autonomous driving, introducing CL3DOD, a framework that mitigates catastrophic forgetting via teacher-student distillation and EMA-based consistency regularization, demonstrating consistent stability-plasticity trade-offs on KITTI and nuScenes.
tldr_zh: 本文首次在多个自动驾驶基准上对室外三维目标检测的类增量学习进行统一跨基准分析，提出CL3DOD框架，通过师生蒸馏和EMA一致性正则缓解灾难性遗忘，并在KITTI和nuScenes上验证了其稳定性-可塑性平衡优势。

title: MirrorComm: A Communication-Efficient Cooperative Perception Framework via Mirrored World Models
summary: Cooperative perception (CP) requires substantial communication bandwidth to exchange sensing information among connected agents. A variety of compression techniques have been proposed to reduce transmission costs while retaining task-relevant information. However, most existing methods follow a frame-wise compression paradigm, overlooking temporal predictability and repeatedly transmitting information that could be inferred from historical context. To address these limitations, we propose MirrorComm, the first world model-based communication-efficient CP framework. Specifically, mirrored world models at the transmitter and receiver predict the transmitter's current observation from a shared history of its reconstructed observations. The transmitter compares this prediction with its current observation and selectively transmits observation updates to correct prediction errors, reducing repeated transmission of predictable information. Experiments on the OPV2V dataset across two downstream tasks including object detection and semantic segmentation show that MirrorComm reduces communication bandwidth requirements by up to approximately 66-fold while maintaining comparable performance to a state-of-the-art (SOTA) method. Ablation studies further demonstrate the effectiveness of the individual components.
summary_zh: 协同感知（CP）需要在互联智能体之间交换感知信息，这要求大量的通信带宽。为降低传输开销同时保留任务相关信息，已有多种压缩方法被提出。然而，大多数现有方法遵循逐帧压缩范式，忽略了时间可预测性，并重复传输可由历史上下文推断的信息。为解决这些局限，我们提出了MirrorComm，这是首个基于世界模型的通信高效协同感知框架。具体而言，发射端和接收端的镜像世界模型根据共享的重建观测历史预测发射端的当前观测。发射端将该预测与其当前观测进行比较，并选择性地传输观测更新以纠正预测误差，从而减少可预测信息的重复传输。在OPV2V数据集上针对目标检测和语义分割两项下游任务的实验表明，MirrorComm将通信带宽需求最多降低约66倍，同时保持与最先进（SOTA）方法相当的性能。消融实验进一步证明了各组成部分的有效性。
tldr: MirrorComm is a world model-based cooperative perception framework that transmits only prediction errors between agents, reducing communication bandwidth by up to ~66x on OPV2V while preserving detection and segmentation performance.
tldr_zh: MirrorComm 是一个基于世界模型的协同感知框架，通过仅传输预测误差，在OPV2V数据集上实现约66倍带宽压缩，同时保持检测和分割性能。

title: Delay-Certified Readiness Barriers for Overactuated Multirotor Allocation Without Lipschitz Constants
summary: Overactuated multirotors can produce the same wrench with many rotor-speed combinations, some of which leave the vehicle unable to change its wrench quickly, e.g., to reject a gust. Readiness barriers keep this ability, the readiness, above a floor, but only in continuous time; with sampled commands and varying speed-controller delays, the available robustness bound covers less than one millisecond. We remove this limit by exploiting the structure of the problem: each rotor responds monotonically and in closed form to its own torque, so the speeds reachable under uncertain switching times lie in a cheaply computed box, and the lowest readiness over that box sits at a corner known in advance. This yields a Lipschitz-free test that a command keeps the readiness above its floor until the next sample, plus a fallback torque that keeps the vehicle on a certified plan. In hexarotor simulations with 2--40~ms delays and $\pm2$~ms jitter, the filter never violated the floor. At $10\pm2$~ms, it matched a delay-compensating predictor within the design envelope and cost 2--30\% more tracking error beyond it, where the predictor alone violated the floor in 2 to 16 of 16 missions.
summary_zh: 过驱动多旋翼能够通过多种旋翼转速组合产生相同的力旋量，其中部分组合会使飞行器无法快速改变其力旋量，例如抵抗阵风时所需的快速响应。就绪度屏障可将该能力（即就绪度）维持在预设下限之上，但仅限于连续时间；在采样指令和变化的速度控制器延迟条件下，可用的鲁棒性界覆盖范围不足一毫秒。我们通过利用该问题的结构特性来消除此限制：每个旋翼对其自身扭矩呈单调且闭式响应，因此在不确定切换时间下可达到的转速集合位于一个计算成本低廉的箱体内，而该箱体内就绪度的最小值位于预先已知的角点。由此，我们得到一个无需利普希茨条件的检验方法，可确保指令在下一个采样时刻之前使就绪度保持在下限之上，同时提供备用扭矩，使飞行器维持经认证的计划轨迹。在六旋翼仿真中，当延迟为2–40毫秒、抖动为±2毫秒时，该滤波器从未违反就绪度下限。在10±2毫秒条件下，其在设计包线内与延迟补偿预测器性能相当，超出包线后跟踪误差增加2–30%，而此时单独使用预测器在16次任务中有2至16次违反了就绪度下限。
tldr: This paper presents a delay-certified readiness barrier filter for overactuated multirotors that guarantees a minimum wrench-change readiness under sampled commands and variable speed-controller delays, using a Lipschitz-free corner test based on monotonic closed-form rotor responses and a certified fallback torque.
tldr_zh: 本文针对过驱动多旋翼，提出一种延迟认证的就绪度屏障滤波器，利用单调闭式转子响应和角点测试，在采样指令和可变速度控制器延迟下保证最小力矩变化就绪度，并提供认证的备份力矩。

title: Clinician-AI Collaboration in Endovascular Neurointerventions: In-Vitro User Study of Copilot Assistance Modes for Robotic Navigation Across the Autonomy Spectrum
summary: Mechanical thrombectomy (MT) is an effective treatment for acute ischemic stroke, yet access remains limited by the availability of neurointerventional expertise. Telerobotic and AI-assisted systems may help address this challenge, but it remains unclear how clinicians interact with different levels of autonomy and how autonomous navigation systems perform in realistic environments. This work introduces Copilot Assistance Modes (CAMs), a framework for clinician-AI collaboration in robotic endovascular navigation spanning the autonomy spectrum from manual operation to full autonomy. In the first in-vitro user study comparing clinician-AI collaboration strategies, 11 experts and two students evaluated six navigation modes in a patient-specific vascular phantom. Objective performance metrics were combined with subjective assessments, including workload and usability. Autonomous performance was additionally evaluated both in silico and in vitro to investigate sim-to-real transfer. Hands-on manual navigation achieved the strongest overall performance (100% success). While fully autonomous navigation achieved 81% success in simulation, performance dropped to 23% in vitro. In contrast, several clinician-AI shared-autonomy modes achieved success rates of 92-97%, approximately four times higher than full autonomy and comparable to direct robotic control (95%), demonstrating mitigation of sim-to-real domain shift through clinician-AI collaboration. Among the evaluated AI-driven approaches, user-directed task delegation and rotational shared control demonstrated the most favorable balance between performance and clinician acceptance. These findings suggest that effective clinician-AI collaboration and allocation of control authority may currently be more important for reliable robotic neurointerventional navigation than increasing autonomy alone.
summary_zh: 机械取栓（MT）是急性缺血性卒中的有效治疗方法，但其可及性仍受限于神经介入专业人员的可用性。远程机器人和人工智能辅助系统可能有助于应对这一挑战，但目前尚不清楚临床医生如何与不同级别的自主性进行交互，以及自主导航系统在真实环境中的表现如何。本研究引入了副驾驶辅助模式（CAMs），这是一个用于机器人血管内导航中临床医生与人工智能协作的框架，涵盖从手动操作到完全自主的自主性谱系。在首个比较临床医生与人工智能协作策略的体外用户研究中，11名专家和两名学生在患者特异性血管体模中评估了六种导航模式。客观性能指标与主观评估相结合，包括工作负荷和可用性。此外，还在计算机模拟和体外环境中对自主性能进行了评估，以研究仿真到现实的迁移。手动直接导航取得了最强的整体性能（100%成功率）。虽然完全自主导航在仿真中达到了81%的成功率，但在体外环境中性能下降至23%。相比之下，几种临床医生与人工智能共享自主模式达到了92-97%的成功率，约为完全自主的四倍，并与直接机器人控制（95%）相当，表明临床医生与人工智能协作可以缓解仿真到现实的域偏移。在所评估的人工智能驱动方法中，用户导向的任务委托和旋转共享控制表现出性能与临床医生接受度之间最有利的平衡。这些发现表明，对于可靠的机器人神经介入导航而言，有效的临床医生与人工智能协作以及控制权限的分配目前可能比单纯提高自主性更为重要。
tldr: This in-vitro user study introduces Copilot Assistance Modes for clinician-AI collaboration in robotic endovascular navigation, showing that shared-autonomy modes achieve 92-97% success versus 23% for full autonomy, mitigating sim-to-real domain shift in mechanical thrombectomy.
tldr_zh: 这项体外用户研究提出了用于机器人血管内导航的Copilot辅助模式，实现临床医生与AI的协作，结果显示共享自主模式成功率达92-97%，而完全自主仅23%，有效缓解了机械取栓中的仿真到现实差距。

title: Toward Uncertainty-Aware, Physics-Grounded Human World Models
summary: A robot that acts around people needs a world model of the human: a belief over the person's body state and a dynamics model that predicts where that state goes next. This abstract argues that two published components form exactly these two halves, and specifies how to couple them. KNOWN [1] reconstructs the 3D human body while estimating both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty in real time (11.6 ms per frame); its aleatoric term identifies unreliable observations, its epistemic term identifies inputs from low-density regions of the training data, and refinement driven by the epistemic term reduces the error on such inputs from 81.3 to 70.3 mm. PhysMoP [2] predicts future body configuration by solving the Euler-Lagrange equations of the body with learned dynamics terms, reducing the 80 ms prediction error from 9.6 to 2.1 mm on Human3.6M and from 12.1 to 0.7 mm on 3DPW. We define the interface between the two, propose three mechanisms by which KNOWN's uncertainty enters PhysMoP, and specify an evaluation protocol on in-the-wild video. No new experimental results are reported here.
summary_zh: 面向在与人类共处环境中行动的机器人，需要建立关于人的世界模型：一个关于人体状态的信念，以及一个预测该状态下一步走向的动力学模型。本摘要论证，两项已发表组件恰好构成这两半，并说明如何将它们耦合起来。KNOWN [1] 在重建三维人体的同时实时估计偶然不确定性和认知不确定性（每帧11.6 ms）；其偶然项识别不可靠观测，其认知项识别来自训练数据低密度区域的输入，而由认知项驱动的细化将此类输入上的误差从81.3 mm降至70.3 mm。PhysMoP [2] 通过求解带有学习动力学项的人体欧拉-拉格朗日方程来预测未来身体构型，在Human3.6M上将80 ms预测误差从9.6 mm降至2.1 mm，在3DPW上从12.1 mm降至0.7 mm。我们定义二者之间的接口，提出KNOWN的不确定性进入PhysMoP的三种机制，并指定一套在野外视频上的评估协议。本文不报告新的实验结果。
tldr: This paper proposes coupling a real-time 3D human body reconstruction method with uncertainty estimation (KNOWN) and a physics-grounded human motion prediction model (PhysMoP) to form a human world model for robots acting around people, defining the interface and evaluation protocol without new experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出将实时3D人体重建与不确定性估计方法（KNOWN）和基于物理的人体运动预测模型（PhysMoP）耦合，形成面向机器人的人体世界模型，定义了接口和评估协议，但未报告新实验结果。

title: Towards end-to-end co-design for one-shot printable task-specific soft robots
summary: Soft robot co-design methods can jointly optimise morphology and control, but the resulting designs are often difficult to manufacture, while manufacturable approaches typically restrict actuator placement or require manual assembly. We present a simulation-based co-design framework that jointly optimises material distribution, pneumatic actuator placement and orientation, and control, while producing designs that can be fabricated monolithically using fused deposition modelling. The framework uses a differentiable 2D plane-stress Material Point Method simulator, incorporating an experimentally validated material model and an empirically derived surrogate model of a 3D-printed inflatable actuator. We demonstrate gradient-based optimisation soft robotic arms for prescribed tip trajectories. Optimised designs are transferred directly from simulation to one-shot monolithic FDM fabrication, with integrated actuators and no post-assembly. Physical experiments demonstrate that the resulting arms reproduce the behaviour predicted in simulation. This framework provides a path from task-level objectives to physically realisable soft robots while retaining substantial freedom over both morphology and actuation.
summary_zh: 软体机器人协同设计方法能够联合优化形态与控制，但由此产生的设计往往难以制造，而可制造的方法通常限制执行器的布置或需要手动组装。我们提出了一种基于仿真的协同设计框架，该框架联合优化材料分布、气动执行器的位置与方向以及控制，同时生成可通过熔融沉积建模进行整体制造的设计。该框架采用可微分的二维平面应力物质点法模拟器，结合了经实验验证的材料模型以及基于经验推导的三维打印充气执行器代理模型。我们展示了针对指定末端轨迹的基于梯度的软体机械臂优化。优化后的设计可直接从仿真转移至一次性整体式FDM制造，集成执行器且无需后续组装。物理实验表明，所得机械臂能够重现仿真中预测的行为。该框架提供了一条从任务级目标到物理可实现软体机器人的路径，同时在形态和驱动方面保留了充分的自由度。
tldr: This paper presents a simulation-based co-design framework that jointly optimizes material distribution, pneumatic actuator placement/orientation, and control for soft robots, producing designs that can be monolithically fabricated via FDM and validated in physical experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于仿真的协同设计框架，联合优化软体机器人的材料分布、气动执行器布局与朝向及控制策略，使设计可通过FDM一体化制造，并通过物理实验验证了仿真预测的行为。

title: Closing the Dynamics Gap through Self-Directed Robotic Interaction
summary: Agentic Real2Sim2Real systems can reconstruct a scene in simulation from camera observations, but contact-rich dynamics such as friction and restitution cannot be observed without interaction. We call this the dynamics gap and present CUE, an agentic system that closes it by interacting with the environment itself. Given only a high-level instruction and no resets, the agent builds its own perception, identifies physical parameters, and targets interactions where its simulation is least accurate. On billiards, CUE reduces held-out ball-position error by 72% relative to the strongest baseline across 25 hidden-physics conditions in simulation, and we further deploy it on a real pool table. More details can be found on the project website: https://cue-dynamics.github.io/
summary_zh: 智能体式真实到仿真再回到真实（Agentic Real2Sim2Real）系统能够从相机观测中在仿真环境中重建场景，但诸如摩擦和恢复系数等接触丰富的动力学特性无法仅通过观测获得。我们将这一现象称为动力学差距（dynamics gap），并提出了CUE，一种通过与环境自身交互来弥合该差距的智能体系统。该系统仅需一条高层指令且无需重置，便能自主构建感知、识别物理参数，并针对仿真中最不准确的交互进行定向优化。在台球场景下，CUE在25种隐藏物理条件下的仿真中，相较于最强基线，将留出法（held-out）球位置误差降低了72%；此外，我们还在真实台球桌上对其进行了部署验证。更多细节请参见项目网站：https://cue-dynamics.github.io/
tldr: CUE is an agentic Real2Sim2Real system that autonomously interacts with its environment to identify and correct unknown physical dynamics (e.g., friction, restitution) in simulation, reducing held-out position error by 72% in billiards and demonstrating real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: CUE 是一个智能体式 Real2Sim2Real 系统，通过自主与环境交互来识别并修正仿真中未知的物理动态（如摩擦、恢复系数），在台球任务中将留出位置误差降低 72%，并已在实际场景中部署。

title: A Study on the Effects of Finger Movements on a Humanoid Hugging Robot
summary: This study aimed to examine the impact of finger movements in hugging robots on users by experimentally investigating how the presence and patterns of such movements affect users psychologically. The results suggest that the presence and patterns of finger movements influence the sensations users seek from the robot; specifically, repetitive movements and asynchronous movements across multiple fingers tended to enhance these sensations. Additionally, simultaneous movement of all fingers and gentle hugging tended to evoke a greater sense of care. Conversely, no differences were observed regarding resistance to physical contact initiated by the robot.
summary_zh: 本研究旨在通过实验探究拥抱机器人中手指动作的存在及其模式如何影响用户心理，从而考察这些动作对用户的影响。结果表明，手指动作的存在及其模式会影响用户从机器人身上寻求的感觉；具体而言，重复性动作和多指异步动作倾向于增强这些感觉。此外，所有手指的同时动作和轻柔的拥抱更易引发被关怀的感觉。相反，在机器人主动发起的身体接触的抗拒程度方面，未观察到显著差异。
tldr: This paper experimentally investigates how finger movements in a humanoid hugging robot affect users' psychological perception, finding that repetitive and asynchronous finger movements enhance certain sensations while simultaneous movement and gentle hugging evoke a greater sense of care.
tldr_zh: 本文通过实验研究人形拥抱机器人手指运动对用户心理感知的影响，发现重复和异步的手指运动可增强某些感受，而所有手指同步运动和轻柔拥抱则唤起更强的关怀感。

title: Beyond Ensemble Disagreement: Predictive STL Monitoring of RL Locomotion under Distribution Shift
summary: RL locomotion policies trained under nominal simulation conditions may encounter distribution shifts that compromise safety. Predictive monitors could anticipate violations, but their world-model forecasts may become unreliable under shift, and ensemble disagreement is not calibrated. We evaluate predictive Signal Temporal Logic (STL) monitoring for frozen Ant-v5 and HalfCheetah-v5 policies using closed-loop world-model rollouts and a three-model ensemble. Across external-force, observation-noise, and mass shifts, predicted robustness ranks HalfCheetah's future STL violations strongly, whereas disagreement does not reliably track observation prediction error or violations. Under severe noise, violations remain common ($64.2\pm24.4\%$ at $K{=}20$ across three PPO seeds), yet current-state robustness without prediction comes within $0.03$ AUROC of predictive robustness. Penalizing predicted robustness by disagreement does not consistently improve ranking. Ant provides complementary per-specification evidence, but its composite target has no positive violations and its any-violation target is single-class in most evaluated seed-condition slices. Overall, predictive robustness provides useful STL-specific ranking but little demonstrated additional ranking value over the current state; these findings caution against treating ensemble disagreement as a reliable indicator of safety uncertainty.
summary_zh: 基于标称仿真条件训练的强化学习运动策略，在部署中可能遭遇分布偏移，从而危及安全性。预测性监控器可用于预判违规行为，但其世界模型在外推场景下的预测可能不可靠，且集成模型之间的分歧缺乏校准。本文针对冻结的Ant-v5和HalfCheetah-v5策略，采用闭环世界模型轨迹滚动及三模型集成方法，评估了预测性信号时序逻辑（STL）监控的有效性。在外部力、观测噪声及质量偏移场景下，预测鲁棒性能够强有力地排序HalfCheetah未来的STL违规情况，而模型分歧则无法可靠地跟踪观测预测误差或违规行为。在强噪声条件下，违规行为依然频发（三个PPO种子在$K{=}20$时违规率为$64.2\pm24.4\%$），然而，不依赖预测的当前状态鲁棒性在AUROC上与预测鲁棒性相差仅$0.03$。通过引入模型分歧对预测鲁棒性进行惩罚，并未能持续提升排序效果。Ant在逐规格层面提供了补充证据，但其复合目标未出现正向违规行为，且其“任何违规”目标在多数评估的种子-条件切片中呈现单一类别。总体而言，预测鲁棒性提供了有价值的STL特定排序能力，但相较于当前状态并未展现出显著的额外排序价值；上述发现提醒我们，不应将集成模型分歧视为安全不确定性的可靠指标。
tldr: This paper evaluates predictive Signal Temporal Logic (STL) monitoring for RL locomotion policies under distribution shift, finding that predicted robustness ranks violations well but adds little value over current-state robustness, and that ensemble disagreement is not a reliable indicator of safety uncertainty.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了分布偏移下RL运动策略的预测性信号时序逻辑（STL）监控，发现预测鲁棒性对违规排序有效，但相比当前状态鲁棒性几乎没有额外价值，且集成分歧不能可靠指示安全不确定性。

title: History-Aware Force Sensing and Tunable Stiffness in a Pneumatic Kresling Origami Cell
summary: Mechanical hysteresis and pneumatic loading complicate contact force estimation from deformation measurements in soft robots. This work presents a 3D-printed polyether block amide (PEBA) Kresling cell with magnetic angular sensing that supports three operating modes: force sensing at zero gauge pressure, force sensing with tunable stiffness under gauge positive pressure, and self-sensing actuation under negative gauge pressure. A multiscale gated recurrent unit (GRU) network estimates contact force from angular histories to account for the the combined effects of geometric deformation and material response. At zero gauge pressure, the model achieves a test RMSE of 0.76~N. Positive gauge pressure approximately doubles the average axial loading stiffness at +20~kPa over the first 3~mm of compression, while pressure-specific models maintain RMSEs below 0.93~N. Under negative gauge pressure, an energy-based compensation model enables contact force estimation using the the model trained at zero gauge pressure, achieving RMSEs of 1.66--2.10~N under quasi-static conditions. These results demonstrate a compact approach to combining force feedback, tunable axial stiffness, and self-sensing actuation in soft origami systems.
summary_zh: 机械迟滞和气动加载使得基于变形测量的软体机器人接触力估计变得复杂。本研究提出了一种带有磁角传感器的三维打印聚醚嵌段酰胺（PEBA）Kresling折纸单元，其支持三种工作模式：零表压下的力传感、正表压下刚度可调的力传感，以及负表压下的自传感驱动。为综合考虑几何变形与材料响应的耦合效应，采用多尺度门控循环单元（GRU）网络从角度历史数据中估计接触力。在零表压条件下，模型测试均方根误差（RMSE）为0.76 N。在+20 kPa正表压下，前3 mm压缩行程内平均轴向加载刚度约提升一倍，而针对特定压力的模型RMSE保持在0.93 N以下。在负表压下，基于能量的补偿模型可利用零表压条件下训练的模型实现接触力估计，在准静态条件下RMSE为1.66～2.10 N。上述结果表明，该研究为软体折纸系统提供了一种集力反馈、可调轴向刚度与自传感驱动于一体的紧凑方案。
tldr: A 3D-printed PEBA Kresling origami cell with magnetic angular sensing and a multiscale GRU estimates contact force under zero, positive, and negative gauge pressures, enabling tunable stiffness and self-sensing actuation.
tldr_zh: 一种3D打印的PEBA Kresling折纸单元，利用磁角度传感和多尺度GRU网络，在零压、正压和负压下估计接触力，实现可调刚度和自感知驱动。

title: Predictive Safety Guardrails Do Not Always Make LLM Agents Safer
summary: Large language model agents increasingly take consequential actions in digital and physical environments, where safety risks may emerge only after multiple interaction steps. This has motivated world-model-driven predictive safety guardrails, which anticipate future consequences before execution. However, existing evaluations largely focus on end-to-end safety outcomes, leaving unclear whether safety gains arise from reliable prediction and faithful use of predicted risks. In this work, we systematically diagnose the prediction-to-action pipeline along three dimensions: how world-model predictions are integrated into decision making, whether the predictions themselves are reliable, and whether their content is faithfully used. Across seven policy models and two safety environments, we find that stronger prediction involvement does not yield monotonic safety gains and can reduce task completion while substantially increasing inference cost. We further find that world-model predictions remain insufficiently reliable, especially over longer horizons, where safety prediction degrades substantially relative to near-term forecasting. Finally, we find that safety gains can persist even under corrupted predictions, while locally verified predictions still leave subsequent safety violations, showing that predictive content is not faithfully incorporated into the decision process. Together, these findings expose a fundamental prediction-to-action gap in current predictive guardrails: producing more or seemingly accurate foresight is insufficient unless that foresight is both reliable and faithfully translated into safer decisions.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型智能体越来越多地在数字和物理环境中采取具有重大后果的行动，而安全风险往往只有在多个交互步骤之后才会显现。这推动了基于世界模型的预测性安全护栏的发展，该类护栏在执行前预判未来后果。然而，现有评估主要聚焦于端到端的安全结果，尚不清楚安全收益是否源于可靠的预测以及对预测风险的忠实利用。在本研究中，我们沿三个维度系统性地诊断从预测到行动的管线：世界模型预测如何整合进决策过程、预测本身是否可靠，以及预测内容是否被忠实使用。基于七个策略模型和两个安全环境，我们发现，更强的预测参与并不会带来单调递增的安全收益，反而可能降低任务完成率，同时显著增加推理成本。我们还发现，世界模型预测的可靠性仍显不足，尤其在较长预测视野下，安全预测相较短期预测显著退化。最后，我们发现，即便在预测被破坏的情况下，安全收益仍可能持续存在，而局部验证通过的预测仍会留下后续的安全违规，这表明预测内容并未被忠实纳入决策过程。以上发现共同揭示了当前预测性安全护栏中一个根本性的“预测—行动”鸿沟：除非预测既可靠又能被忠实地转化为更安全的决策，否则产生更多或看似更准确的预见并不足以带来安全保障。
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates predictive safety guardrails for LLM agents, revealing a prediction-to-action gap where stronger prediction integration does not reliably improve safety, predictions degrade over long horizons, and safety gains persist under corrupted predictions, indicating unreliable and unfaithful use of foresight.
tldr_zh: 本文系统评估了LLM代理的预测性安全护栏，揭示了预测到行动之间的差距：更强的预测整合并不能可靠提升安全性，长周期预测性能下降，且即使在预测被破坏时安全收益仍存在，表明预测内容不可靠且未被忠实利用。

title: HIVE-Diff: High Frame Rate HDR Video Reconstruction from a Single LDR Frame and Events
summary: High frame rate HDR video is important in applications such as autonomous driving and scientific imaging, where rapid motion and extreme illumination often occur simultaneously. Conventional frame cameras face a trade-off between temporal resolution and dynamic range, while event cameras provide complementary high-speed brightness-change measurements over a wide illumination range. These properties have motivated event-based HDR reconstruction, with existing methods broadly following event-only and hybrid event-frame paradigms. Event-only HDR reconstruction, however, suffers from brightness and color drift due to the lack of absolute intensity references. Hybrid event-frame methods alleviate this ambiguity using low-dynamic-range (LDR) frames as anchors, but most perform one-to-one HDR reconstruction at available LDR timestamps. In this work, we investigate single-reference HDR temporal expansion, reconstructing N HDR frames from one LDR reference and events instead of N aligned LDR observations. We develop HIVE-Diff, an event-conditioned video diffusion framework that decomposes the task into event-guided temporal generation and HDR content completion. Because paired real HDR-event data are scarce, we train on synthetic data and adapt the model to real event domains using LDR-event sequences as proxy supervision with teacher-student distillation. Experiments on synthetic and multiple real-world datasets demonstrate strong reconstruction quality and robust real-data adaptation.
summary_zh: 高帧率HDR视频在自动驾驶和科学成像等应用中具有重要意义，这些场景中快速运动与极端光照条件往往同时存在。传统帧相机面临时间分辨率与动态范围之间的权衡，而事件相机则能在宽光照范围内提供互补的高速亮度变化测量。这些特性催生了基于事件相机的HDR重建研究，现有方法主要分为纯事件范式与事件-帧混合范式两类。然而，纯事件HDR重建由于缺乏绝对强度参考，容易出现亮度和色彩漂移问题。事件-帧混合方法通过引入低动态范围（LDR）帧作为锚点来缓解这一不确定性，但大多数方法仅在现有LDR时间戳处进行一对一HDR重建。在本研究中，我们探索了单参考HDR时间扩展方法，即利用一个LDR参考帧和事件数据重建N个HDR帧，而无需N个对齐的LDR观测。我们提出了HIVEDiff，一种事件条件视频扩散框架，将任务分解为事件引导的时间生成和HDR内容补全两个子任务。由于配对的真实HDR事件数据稀缺，我们在合成数据上训练模型，并通过教师-学生蒸馏方式，利用LDR-事件序列作为代理监督，将模型适应到真实事件域。在合成数据集和多个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，该方法具有出色的重建质量和稳健的真实数据适应能力。
tldr: This paper proposes HIVE-Diff, an event-conditioned video diffusion framework that reconstructs high frame rate HDR videos from a single LDR frame and events, targeting autonomous driving applications. It uses teacher-student distillation to adapt from synthetic to real data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了HIVE-Diff，一种事件条件视频扩散框架，从单个LDR帧和事件重建高帧率HDR视频，面向自动驾驶应用，并通过教师-学生蒸馏实现从合成数据到真实数据的适应。

title: OpenZilo: An Open Smart-Ring Platform for Human-Centric Sensing and Interaction with Robots
summary: Wearable robot interfaces must connect user input to timely physical action. We present the proposed platform, an open smart-ring platform for studying this connection across task stages. The ring integrates a microphone, an inertial measurement unit, photoplethysmography, and skin-temperature sensing. Its software architecture separates acquisition, event interpretation, interaction policy, and robot execution. We characterize seven operating modes and evaluate speech and gesture control with 10 participants. Across five commands and 250 trials per modality, speech and gestures achieved task success rates of 90.4% and 88.8%, respectively. Recognition accuracy exceeded task success for both modalities. Gaussian hidden Markov models achieved higher accuracy than a support vector machine across three vocabulary sizes, with longer scoring times. Following a shared spoken task start, gesture-based adjustments had shorter median response times than speech. Whole-task success was 70.0% with gestures and 64.0% with speech. We further examine physiological-event-triggered robot interaction using simulated event notifications. Mean notification-receipt-to-arrival times were 11.71 s for the robot and 9.20 s for an on-site person. These descriptive findings support evaluating wearable robot interfaces through both recognition and physical outcomes, with timing measures appropriate to each task stage.
tldr: OpenZilo is an open smart-ring platform integrating microphone, IMU, PPG, and skin-temperature sensing to enable human-centric sensing and interaction with robots, evaluated on speech and gesture control and physiological-event-triggered interaction.
tldr_zh: OpenZilo 是一个开源智能戒指平台，集成麦克风、IMU、PPG 和皮温传感，用于以人为中心的机器人感知与交互，并评估了语音、手势控制及生理事件触发的交互。

title: A Tightly Coupled Magnetic-Inertial SLAM System for Field Robots
summary: Field robots operating in mines, tunnels, and disaster areas require reliable localization despite GNSS denial and degraded camera and LiDAR measurements caused by dust, smoke, or poor illumination. Missions involving both ground and aerial robots further motivate complementary sensing modalities that do not depend on visibility, preinstalled infrastructure, or wheel contact. This letter presents MISLAM, a tightly coupled magnetic-inertial simultaneous localization and mapping system using an IMU and a nine-magnetometer array, without relying on external odometry or platform-specific motion assumptions. The system combines the inertial navigation model with local polynomial magnetic-field models for short-term motion estimation and a global Gaussian process model for drift correction using an error-state Kalman filter. Offline evaluation on three indoor datasets collected with a handheld rig shows reductions in total endpoint closure error of 45.7% - 78.0% relative to magnetic-inertial odometry. Under poor illumination, MISLAM maintains tracking after visual-inertial odometry fails, achieving a horizontal closure error of 0.332 m, although vertical drift remains a limitation. These results support magnetic-inertial SLAM as a complementary localization modality for robotic sensor suites operating under degraded visual conditions.
tldr: MISLAM is a tightly coupled magnetic-inertial SLAM system using an IMU and nine-magnetometer array for field robot localization under GNSS denial and degraded visual conditions, achieving 45.7%-78.0% endpoint closure error reductions versus magnetic-inertial odometry.
tldr_zh: MISLAM是一种紧耦合的磁惯性SLAM系统，使用IMU和九磁力计阵列，在GNSS拒止和视觉退化条件下为野外机器人提供定位，相比磁惯性里程计将端点闭合误差降低45.7%-78.0%。

title: To Coordinate or Not to Coordinate? Learning to Swim with Eight Soft Arms
summary: Does effective swimming with multiple underactuated soft arms require explicit coordination between arms? We hypothesize that an eight-arm swimmer can control its swimming speed and direction by independently learning each arm's actuation amplitude under a shared rhythmic drive, without prescribed inter-arm phase coupling. To test this hypothesis, we compare three reinforcement learning-based control strategies using proximal policy optimization (PPO): (1) learning arm-specific actuation amplitudes without inter-arm phase coupling, (2) learning actuation amplitudes with prescribed inter-arm phase coupling, and (3) directly learning actuator commands through end-to-end PPO without an explicit rhythmic structure. Across 200 episodes with randomized three-dimensional velocity commands, the controller without phase coupling satisfies the tracking criterion in 169 episodes, compared with 117 for the phase-coupled controller and 28 for end-to-end PPO. Straight-line swimming and commanded direction-change trials further demonstrate more accurate velocity tracking without phase coupling. These findings suggest that effective eight-arm swimming does not require prescribed inter-arm phase coupling, but can instead be achieved through learned arm-specific amplitude modulation within a rhythmic control structure.
tldr: This paper compares three PPO-based control strategies for an eight-arm soft swimmer, finding that learning arm-specific actuation amplitudes under a shared rhythmic drive without explicit inter-arm phase coupling yields the best velocity tracking performance.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了八臂软体游泳机器人的三种PPO控制策略，发现在共享节律驱动下独立学习各臂驱动幅度而无需显式臂间相位耦合，能获得最佳的游动速度跟踪性能。

title: Late Autumn: LLM Agents Specialize a General Multi-Robot Planner for One Warehouse
summary: No algorithm is best on all problems, but a real warehouse is a narrow problem: its layout and processes rarely change. Operators still run one general multi-robot planner at many sites, because experts cannot tune it for each one. In this work, which we call Late Autumn, we explore whether LLM coding agents running autonomous research can specialize a general planner for one site, trading generality for throughput, much as post-training adapts a pretrained LLM to one task. We study six campaigns on a lifelong planner that combines task assignment with multi-agent path finding, on a floor modeled on an existing automated warehouse. We find that (1) the agents raise throughput by 22--60%, and the gains hold on unseen seeds; (2) they rediscover known MAPF mechanisms, such as corridor-exit priorities, local guidance, and rollouts, and independent campaigns find the same bottleneck; (3) the gains largely carry over to another layout, a larger fleet, and other service times, shrink with a smaller fleet, and mostly vanish under an outbound-heavy demand mix; and (4) each final patch (0.7k--2.4k lines) is a chain of scored commits with a median step of 27 lines, so experts can review it, and review finds problems that the score misses; some patches multiply planner compute by over 100x. LLM agents can therefore turn each site's bias into extra throughput at little engineering cost, with reviewable patches; we expect experts to shift toward designing insightful metrics and fast simulators that mirror the real problem.
tldr: LLM coding agents autonomously specialize a general multi-robot warehouse planner for a single site, raising throughput 22-60% via reviewable patch chains that rediscover known MAPF mechanisms.
tldr_zh: LLM编码智能体自主地将通用多机器人仓库规划器针对单一场地专门化，通过可审查的补丁链使吞吐量提升22-60%，并重新发现已知的MAPF机制。

title: Myoelectric Control for Upper-Limb Exoskeletons: A Decoder-Shaper-Controller Framework, Design Guidelines, and Future Directions
summary: Myoelectric Control Systems (MCSs) enable voluntary control of wearable robots through muscle activity. However, intention decoding, assistance shaping, and low-level actuator control are often not explicitly distinguished, making their contributions difficult to evaluate and compare. This review introduces a functional decoder-shaper-controller framework for continuous myoelectric control of upper-limb exoskeletons. The decoder estimates an intention-related variable from surface electromyography (sEMG), the shaper maps it to a control reference according to an assistance policy, and the controller realizes that reference through actuator control. This decomposition separates intention estimation from assistance-policy design and enables comparison of heterogeneous architectures. Representative approaches are critically examined in terms of module design, calibration, and evaluation. The analysis highlights that the shaper, despite determining the magnitude and shape of assistance, lacks established design and tuning methodologies and is often embedded within the decoder or controller. Key open issues include inconsistent reporting of assistance levels, limited use of interaction-aware stability and passivity tools, and insufficient validation across degrees of freedom, users, and tasks. Building on these findings, this review provides design guidelines for systematic module-wise tuning and identifies future research priorities to bridge the gap between accurate intention decoding and safe, effective, and generalizable assistance under real-world operating conditions.
tldr: This review introduces a decoder-shaper-controller framework for decomposing continuous myoelectric control of upper-limb exoskeletons, critically examining module designs and providing design guidelines for systematic tuning.
tldr_zh: 这篇综述提出了一个用于上肢外骨骼连续肌电控制的解码器-整形器-控制器框架，批判性地审视了模块设计，并为系统化调优提供了设计指南。

title: TRAILS: Trajectory Generation for Automated Indoor Locomotion Studies
summary: Virtual reality experiments involving navigation and simulated robot motion often require large, realistic environments and numerous distinct trajectories to avoid repetitive navigation while providing sufficient variation for controlled experiments. Designing such scenarios manually is labor-intensive, particularly when trajectories must satisfy predefined geometric and kinematic constraints while remaining diverse and comparable across experimental conditions. This paper presents TRAILS, an automated framework for generating complete virtual navigation scenarios consisting of an environment layout, a path, and a time-parameterized motion profile. The framework combines a constraint-based procedural environment generator inspired by Wave Function Collapse, trajectory generation using optimized cubic Bézier curves, and speed-profile generation subject to kinematic constraints. The generated scenarios provide diverse indoor environments with corridors, open spaces, and obstacles, together with trajectories of identical duration that vary in path geometry, wall proximity, and velocity profiles while minimizing systematic dependencies between these characteristics. The framework is designed as an easy-to-use tool requiring only a small number of intuitive user-defined parameters to automatically generate large sets of distinct navigation scenarios satisfying prescribed geometric and kinematic constraints. By relying on explicit, seed-controlled algorithmic procedures rather than data-driven models, the generated scenarios remain transparent, reproducible, and configurable, making the framework well suited for telepresence and human-subject experiments. The code is available at https://github.com/JucciK/Trails .
tldr: TRAILS is a procedural framework that automatically generates complete VR navigation scenarios—environment layouts via Wave Function Collapse and constraint-optimized cubic Bézier trajectories with kinematic speed profiles—for controlled indoor locomotion and telepresence experiments.
tldr_zh: TRAILS 是一个程序化框架，通过波函数坍缩生成环境布局，并用基于优化的三次贝塞尔曲线和运动学速度剖面生成完整轨迹，用于受控的室内导航与远程临场实验。

title: Swarm Choreography Made Simple: Superposed Guiding Vector Fields for Rigid Formation Path Following
summary: This paper presents a decentralized guiding vector field framework for rigid formation path following in multi- UAV systems based on the superposition of simple rule-driven vector fields. Each control objective is encoded as a dedicated vector-field component: a normalized tangential term to ensure progression along a prescribed geometric path at a desired speed, a convergence term driving the formation toward the path, a local coordination term that preserves the desired formation shape through a pseudo-path parameter, and a local separation term for inter-agent collision avoidance. The coordination mechanism requires the exchange of only a single scalar per agent, resulting in low communication bandwidth. Partial theoretical results establish convergence of the swarm to the desired path and formation in the absence of the sepa- ration term, while collision avoidance is formally guaranteed. The approach is experimentally validated using a swarm of five quadrotors executing two 3D choreographies. The first experiment involves tracking a helical path while maintaining a rigid V-shaped formation. The second demonstrates a spiral- like motion obtained by a rotating circular formation tracking a vertical line. The experimental results support the effectiveness and practical applicability of the proposed framework.
tldr: This paper proposes a decentralized guiding vector field framework for rigid formation path following in multi-UAV systems, built by superposing simple rule-driven vector field components, and validates it with five quadrotors executing 3D choreographies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于多无人机刚性编队路径跟踪的分布式引导向量场框架，通过叠加简单的规则驱动向量场分量实现，并用五架四旋翼执行三维编队实验验证。

title: An intelligent satellite must do nothing well
summary: Autonomous inspection of a resident space object is usually posed as a contest between classical next-best-view planning and reinforcement learning. We argue that the choice of algorithm is the least informative of the design axes. An inspector spacecraft has no rest state: when it stops thrusting, orbital dynamics carry it along a natural trajectory that can be used to observe the target at no fuel cost. On a controlled ladder in which one design axis is varied at a time, fuel efficiency turns out to be set by three things: whether the agent is allowed to drift, whether its state records where drifting has taken it, and whether its planning horizon is long enough for the benefit to appear. Removing any one of them doubles the fuel bill or more. The algorithm still matters, but through what it can represent: a model-based agent whose learned world model ignores fuel spends several times more of it. Finally, no learned policy is safe by construction, and a control barrier function filter beneath the decision layer removed every keep-out-zone violation in two thousand evaluation episodes.
tldr: This paper studies autonomous spacecraft inspection, arguing that the choice of control algorithm is less important than allowing the spacecraft to drift, recording drift state, and using a sufficiently long planning horizon. It shows that these factors drastically affect fuel efficiency and that a control barrier function can ensure safety.
tldr_zh: 本文研究自主航天器检查，认为控制算法选择不如允许漂移、记录漂移状态和使用足够长的规划范围重要，并展示这些因素极大影响燃料效率且控制屏障函数能保证安全。

title: Gibbs Variational Last Layers for Long-Horizon Dynamics Learning
summary: Accurate long-horizon probabilistic predictions of dynamical systems are a prerequisite for model-based decision-making. Variational Bayesian last layers (VBLLs) are an attractive model class for this setting, offering tractable uncertainty at near-deterministic cost, yet they are trained exclusively with single-step likelihood objectives that may be insufficient for reliable multi-step rollouts. We revisit VBLLs through the lens of Gibbs variational inference, which decouples posterior inference from the choice of training loss. Building on this perspective, we introduce a family of multi-step training losses that progressively incorporate long-horizon structure, robustness via continuous ranked probability scores (CRPS), and training on full autoregressive rollouts. Our approach retains the simplicity of VBLLs while directly optimizing for multi-step predictive quality. Across illustrative synthetic environments, a diverse suite of chaotic dynamical systems, and real-world data, we show that multi-step, CRPS-based objectives substantially improve long-horizon accuracy and distributional fit, consistently outperforming single-step likelihood training.
tldr: The paper introduces multi-step, CRPS-based training objectives for variational Bayesian last layers to improve long-horizon probabilistic predictions of dynamical systems, showing consistent gains over single-step likelihood training.
tldr_zh: 本文为变分贝叶斯末层引入多步、基于CRPS的训练目标，以改进动力系统的长时间概率预测，在多个基准上优于单步似然训练。

title: Source-Resolved Collective Cognition in Robotics: Mathematical Foundations for Multimodal and Collective Estimation, and Their Reach across the Cognition Loop
summary:
The Generalized Singular Value Decomposition (GSVD) is a central tool for comparing two linear operators that act on the same unknown. Once the output metrics are fixed, it answers the basis-independent question "along which state directions does the first operator dominate the second, and by how much?".
  This foundational volume builds the GSVD and its surrounding estimation theory from the ground up. Part I re-derives every piece of linear algebra and statistical estimation machinery needed later -- inner products, the four subspaces, orthogonal matrices, the spectral theorem, quadratic forms, the ordinary SVD, Lie-group tangent perturbations, Jacobians, covariance, whitening, Fisher information, CCA, mutual information, discrimination criteria, and covariance intersection -- with self-contained derivations and worked numerical examples. Part II states the GSVD in both a transparent and a dimensionally general form, then proves it by two complementary routes. Part III works one small matrix pair through five different lenses, each computed by hand and verified numerically. Part IV separates information attribution, subspace geometry, statistical dependence, and decision-theoretic discrimination for collective systems. Part V evaluates the role and limits of the GSVD across the cognition loop. Part VI covers numerical practice, including a tested reference implementation.
  Every number printed in this document was verified in double precision. Where a statement is an assumption rather than a theorem, it is labelled as such.
tldr: This foundational volume develops the Generalized Singular Value Decomposition (GSVD) and its estimation theory, applying it to collective multimodal estimation and the cognition loop in robotics, with extensive self-contained derivations and numerical verification.
tldr_zh: 这本基础著作深入发展了广义奇异值分解（GSVD）及其估计理论，并将其应用于机器人中的集体多模态估计和认知循环，提供了大量自包含的推导和数值验证。

title: Interactive 3D Cutaway Visualization for Subsurface Target Localization in Robot-Assisted Surgery
summary: Purpose: Blended augmented reality (AR) overlays can provide ambiguous depth cues in which subsurface anatomy floats above the tissue surface. We investigate whether an interactive 3D cutaway visualization can improve robot-assisted target localization. Methods: We propose Virtual Box, an interactive 3D cutaway interface that allows users to independently manipulate the viewing perspective to inspect subsurface targets. In a controlled, counterbalanced within-subject tissue phantom study, 15 engineering students used Virtual Box and a depth-enhanced blended AR overlay to position a da Vinci instrument at virtual targets in a water tank. We used registered 3D transrectal ultrasound to measure 3D localization error and depth error. We also collected completion time and subjective ratings. Results: Virtual Box reduced mean 3D error from 12.92 to 4.96 mm (61.6% reduction) and depth error from 9.48 to 2.07 mm (78.2% reduction; both p < 0.001). Spatial understanding, depth perception, and confidence ratings were higher (all unadjusted p < 0.001), but completion time increased from 21.64 to 32.58 s (p = 0.008). Overall workload did not differ significantly. Conclusion: Virtual Box improved localization accuracy and perceived spatial understanding in this controlled task, with additional completion time, supporting further evaluation for surgical navigation.
tldr: This paper presents Virtual Box, an interactive 3D cutaway visualization interface for robot-assisted surgery, demonstrating improved subsurface target localization accuracy and depth perception compared to blended AR overlays in a phantom study.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人辅助手术的交互式3D剖切可视化界面Virtual Box，在体模研究中证明其相比混合AR叠加能显著提高皮下靶点定位精度和深度感知。

title: Design and Experimental Validation of the Separation and Deployment System for the CHERI Lunar Micro-Rovers
summary: Reliable separation mechanisms are critical for planetary micro-rovers, which must withstand launch vibrations and then eject the vehicle clear of the lander. This paper presents the design, optimization, and testing of the separation system of the CHERI (Challenging Environment Exploration Rovers for Intelligence) lunar micro-rovers. Sized for a 5 kg vehicle, the assembly comprises an aluminum ground plate, a central non-explosive hold-down and release mechanism, and an asymmetric four-spring ejection array. Initial separation trials revealed a velocity deficit caused by energy absorption in the flexible wheel-legs and chassis during the ejection stroke. This loss was represented as equivalent chassis damping in a multi-body dynamic model, and the springs were re-optimized accordingly. Early hardware iterations failed vibration testing, first through spring jamming in the guide housings and then through a 34 Hz fundamental mode of the flat ground plate. A density-based topology optimization raised the fundamental frequency to 84 Hz, above the 70 Hz requirement of the lander, within a 1.6 kg mass budget. The final configuration passed acceptance-level sinusoidal vibration, random vibration, and shock testing without structural degradation. Separation tests with a weight-matched one-sixth mass model, tracked by optical motion capture, confirmed clearance of the lander and reproduced the simulated free flight to within the run-to-run variation of the measured ejection velocity. These tests further showed that landing outcome is dominated by touchdown and settling dynamics, indicating that the residual pitch rate is the main controllable design parameter and confirming self-righting recovery as an integral element of the deployment architecture.
tldr: The paper designs, optimizes, and experimentally validates the separation and deployment system for the 5 kg CHERI lunar micro-rovers, including hold-down/release mechanism, spring ejection array, and topology-optimized ground plate that passed vibration/shock testing and reproduced simulated free flight.
tldr_zh: 本文设计、优化并实验验证了用于5公斤级CHERI月球微型漫游车的分离与部署系统，包括压紧释放机构、弹簧弹射阵列和拓扑优化底板，通过了振动与冲击测试，并复现了仿真自由飞行结果。

title: Touching Projected Agents through the DAT Screen -System Design and Questions of Interaction Boundaries-
summary: Touching a virtual agent involves more than detecting a finger on a display: the contact surface can deform and resist the user's push, and the agent can respond to that action. We describe the Desktop Amid Touch (DAT) screen, which combines spatial projection onto a semi-transparent, deformable mesh with touch sensing and motorized control of resistance to indentation. An initial prototype detected a single touch and estimated its position and depth from tension changes around a flexible projection screen. A subsequent prototype added motorized tension control to vary the screen's resistance to indentation. We describe the tension-controlled DAT implementation and its demonstrations, distinguishing what has been observed from what remains an open design question. These capabilities raise a design question: should touchable virtual agents respond as though they had preferences or boundaries, and under what conditions should such behavior be implemented on systems like DAT. The present paper describes a system and frames this question; it does not establish how users interpret an agent's refusal or consent.
tldr: The paper presents the Desktop Amid Touch (DAT) screen, a deformable touch display with spatial projection and motorized resistance, and raises design questions about how virtual agents should respond to touch, including boundaries and consent.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了桌面触觉投影屏（DAT），该屏幕结合了空间投影、可变形网格和电机控制的阻力，并提出了关于虚拟代理应如何响应触摸（包括边界和同意）的设计问题。

title: Directional Bounded-Confidence Matrix Alignment in Vicsek Flocking
summary: This paper proposes a directional bounded-confidence variant of the discrete-time Vicsek multiagent model, in which pairwise heading alignment is modulated by a state-dependent, positive semidefinite matrix that independently gates orthogonal radial and tangential components in the instantaneous line-of-sight frame. We analyze the normalized, matrix-weighted system dynamics, proving a uniform non-vanishing bound on proposal vectors that guarantees global well-posedness across arbitrary network states. For local small-spread states under complete metric interaction, we prove linear geometric contraction of the heading diameter and establish an offline-verifiable spatial bootstrap condition that guarantees metric contact preservation and coincidence avoidance a priori. A counterexample demonstrates invariant polarized states on connected matrix graphs, delineating systemic structural limits. Numerical experiments against unfiltered Vicsek averaging, scalar tied confidence, trace-matched scalar baselines, and restricted-angle rules demonstrate component-selective filtering without rejected-channel leakage, along with improved fixed-bound alignment on multi-seed benchmarks across varying population densities.
tldr: This paper introduces a directional bounded-confidence variant of the Vicsek flocking model, where pairwise heading alignment is gated by a state-dependent matrix separating radial and tangential components, with proofs of well-posedness, geometric contraction, and a counterexample showing invariant polarized states.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Vicsek集群模型的方向性有限置信变体，其中成对航向对齐由状态依赖矩阵控制，该矩阵在瞬时视线坐标系中分别门控径向和切向分量，并证明了适定性、几何收缩以及展示不变极化状态的反例。

title: Directional Bounded-Confidence Cucker-Smale Flocking
summary: This paper introduces a directional bounded-confidence extension of the Cucker--Smale (CS) flocking model that decomposes pairwise relative velocities into independent radial and tangential channels within the instantaneous line-of-sight frame. Gating these components via compactly supported kernels creates a time-varying, state-dependent, matrix-weighted interaction that strictly generalizes classical scalar CS alignment. We establish an exact energy-dissipation identity with conserved mean velocity and prove exponential velocity consensus under a sliding-window persistent excitation (PE) condition formulated directly on the disagreement subspace. Furthermore, we derive a CS bounded-diameter criterion separating metric decay from aggregate directional coercivity, along with a cluster convergence guarantee. Simulations validate the exact dissipation balance and demonstrate that directional gating successfully restores global alignment in scenarios where traditional isotropic tied-confidence laws remain polarized.
tldr: This paper proposes a directional bounded-confidence extension of the Cucker-Smale flocking model with independent radial and tangential gating kernels, proving exponential velocity consensus under a sliding-window persistent excitation condition and a bounded-diameter criterion.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Cucker-Smale群集模型的方向性有限置信度扩展，通过独立门控径向和切向速度分量，在滑动窗口持续激励条件下证明了指数速度共识和有界直径准则。

title: Creating Hybrid Interactive Narrative Systems with LLM: From Formal Description to Evaluation
summary: Interactive narratives let users shape a story while an Experience Manager (EM) keeps it coherent, balancing player freedom against authorial control. Large Language Models now enable a new generation of hybrid EMs, which combine run-time generation from free-text input with symbolic narrative control. However, their heterogeneity makes them hard to compare: A manager's behaviour is generally tied to the unique and specific scenario in which it operates, and much of its decision-making takes place outside of any explicit and verifiable structure. We address this with an LLM-based narrative platform whose managers are interchangeable modules operating over a shared symbolic world model of facts, operations, and goals. Because every applied operation carries explicit preconditions and effects, each session can be analysed as a plan through a common state-transition representation and evaluated, independently of how the manager works internally, with shared indicators of four properties: player agency, EM controllability, author intent, and robustness. We implement three contrasting managers, based respectively on open generation, Monte Carlo repair, and autonomous characters, and compare them through functional analysis on an interactive Little Red Riding Hood scenario. The results show that no manager dominates on every property, giving authors and EM designers a concrete basis to select a manager according to their priorities.
tldr: This paper introduces an LLM-based platform for hybrid interactive narrative systems with interchangeable Experience Managers, and evaluates three contrasting managers on a shared symbolic world model using indicators of player agency, controllability, author intent, and robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个基于LLM的混合交互叙事系统平台，支持可互换的体验管理器，并在共享符号世界模型上评估三种管理器，从玩家代理性、可控性、作者意图和鲁棒性等方面进行比较。

title: Human-Oriented World Model
summary: Supporting a person over repeated interactions requires interpreting their current state in context and anticipating its subsequent evolution. We formulate the \emph{Human-Oriented World Model} (HOWM) as a conceptual framework centered on task-relevant human states and their evolution. HOWM connects current observations and individual history with environmental and social context to organize continuing state estimation, personalized dynamics prediction, and action support. Dynamic expectations and new observations jointly inform the current estimate, which in turn anchors personalized forecasts based on shared knowledge and individual experience. An external policy relates forecasts under alternative conditions to the person's goals, preferences, and constraints when considering support. Actual responses and outcomes provide evidence for revising the state estimate and personal dynamic patterns, thereby informing subsequent estimation, prediction, and support. We illustrate the framework through hypothetical training and learning scenarios. Our research agenda asks whether accumulated interaction experience improves subsequent estimation and prediction, and whether using the model helps the person pursue their goals over time.
tldr: The paper introduces a conceptual framework, the Human-Oriented World Model (HOWM), for modeling task-relevant human states and their evolution to support personalized assistance over repeated interactions, but it is purely conceptual without empirical validation or a clear robotic/embodied application.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个概念框架——面向人的世界模型（HOWM），用于对任务相关的人类状态及其演变进行建模，以在重复交互中提供个性化支持，但该工作纯属概念性，缺乏实证验证或明确的机器人/具身应用。

title: Defining Autonomous Weapon Systems: A schematic framework for refined purpose-driven definitions
summary: The literature on autonomous weapon systems (AWS) includes many proposed definitions for these (types of) systems, with core disagreements between scholars, governments, and international regulatory bodies. In this article, we present and critique prevailing (classes of) definitions, arguing that what is needed is not a singular definition, but rather a definitional framework which allows one to classify different sorts of AWS within the same conceptual family. Recognizing we cannot foresee all future AWS, we show how variations on a broadly accepted definition can be used to produce a definitional schema which can be easily modified in order to classify various concepts belonging to the class of AWS.
tldr: This paper critiques existing definitions of autonomous weapon systems (AWS) and proposes a flexible definitional framework (schema) to classify different AWS within a conceptual family, acknowledging that future systems cannot be fully foreseen.
tldr_zh: 本文批判了现有的自主武器系统（AWS）定义，提出一个灵活的、目的驱动的定义框架（模式），以便将不同类型的AWS归入同一概念家族，同时承认无法预见所有未来系统。

title: 3D Gaussian Splatting within Self-Learned Neural View-Dependent Color Fields
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a vital tool in novel view synthesis. 3D Gaussian functions with attributes like color, opacity, and scale are stacked together to explicitly model a radiance field. However, discrete 3D Gaussians usually produce poor depth with few geometry details but lots of floaters, which hinders the effective modeling of smooth radiance fields. To address this issue, we propose to learn a radiance field within a continuous view-dependent color field parameterized by neural networks. With continuous constraints in color, the bias on low-frequency signals of neural networks can highly encourage the geometry modeling to contribute to high-frequency color variations on images, getting rid of solely relying on the color attribute itself. Moreover, we impose a constraint to improve the Lipschitz continuity of the neural color field, making large changes of each Gaussian's color also match with large changes of its position in terms of a ratio. To this end, we additionally introduce novel self-learning strategies to improve the learning of the neural view-dependent color field without any external knowledge or priors, aiming for better generalization on unseen scenes. Our numerical and visual comparisons on widely used benchmarks justify our idea and show better ability of high fidelity geometry recovery in 3DGS. Project page: https://github.com/yangyixi21/Neural-Color-Fields-3DGS.

title: 3L-D: A Low-Light Level Dataset from a Sensor-Agnostic, Alignment-Preserving Acquisition Framework
summary: Supervised low-light image and video enhancement has achieved remarkable progress, yet current models remain fundamentally constrained by the limitations of existing datasets. Prevailing methods typically rely on uncontrolled ambient captures, camera parameter manipulation (e.g., exposure or ISO adjustments), or neutral density filters, failing to replicate authentic night-sky near-infrared spectral content and genuine low-photon noise distributions. Furthermore, capturing dynamic paired sequences without introducing warping artifacts or sensor-specific biases remains an open challenge. In this paper, we introduce 3L-Dataset, a physically calibrated low-light image and video dataset generated using a modular, sensor-agnostic acquisition framework. Our test bench faithfully reproduces the standardized Midavaine night level scale from Level 1 (full moon, approximately 1000 mlx) down to Level 5 (overcast moonless night, approximately 0.1 mlx), spanning the visible to near-infrared spectrum across diverse realistic environments, including countryside, forest, urban, and desert scale models. Using high-precision programmable mechanical actuation, our acquisition framework guarantees sub-pixel spatial alignment across synchronized sextuplets, each composed of one reference image and five corresponding images acquired at the five standardized night levels, without post-processing image warping. We evaluate multiple representative deep learning baselines across varying night levels, revealing critical trade-offs between reconstruction fidelity, perceptual quality, and inference latency under severe photon starvation. The modular acquisition framework can be adapted to different cameras, optical systems, sensor technologies, and resolutions, enabling the dataset to be continuously expanded.

title: A Bayesian Framework for Safe Optimal Control of Unknown Systems from Input-Output Data
summary: As control engineering is applied to increasingly complex systems, learning-based control, which uses empirical data to reduce the reliance on first-principles models, has emerged as a promising paradigm. However, such approaches must cope with nonlinear and stochastic dynamics, the absence of state measurements, and scarce data, while ensuring safe operation under constraints, which requires rigorous uncertainty quantification. Whereas existing methods treat these challenges in isolation, this article proposes a Bayesian framework that jointly addresses them. A prior in state-space form is updated from input-output data using particle Markov chain Monte Carlo methods, yielding a representation of joint uncertainty over dynamics and latent states. Building on this representation, a validation procedure is developed that provides probabilistic guarantees for constraint satisfaction under arbitrary causal control laws. For control synthesis, a formulation penalizing the conditional value-at-risk of the constraint function is proposed, together with an adaptive calibration mechanism that adjusts the performance-robustness trade-off to achieve a desired robustness level. The probability of successful certification is characterized theoretically. The framework is extended to a receding-horizon setting, where posterior updates from new measurements allow the controller to progressively reduce uncertainty and improve performance. The approach is demonstrated on the optimal control of a vertical farm.

title: A Capitulation Direction Emerges With Scale and Is Causally Load-Bearing Where Validation Is Strong: Eight Models, Two Families, and Five Measurement Hazards
summary: Sycophancy in language models is well documented as a behaviour but poorly localised as a mechanism. We ask whether capitulation under user pushback, the abandonment of a correct answer when a user objects, corresponds to a linear direction in the residual stream, and whether such a direction emerges with scale. Across eight instruction-tuned models spanning 0.5B to 14B parameters in two families, under a pre-registered protocol with leave-one-question-out cross-validation, within-question permutation nulls, and a positive control, we find no usable direction below 7B and a direction that clears our validation gate at 7B, 8B and 14B. Ablating that direction in Qwen2.5-7B reduces the rate at which the model reverses a correct answer by 4.8 percentage points, roughly a quarter in relative terms, while the identical intervention on a gate-failing direction and on a marginally passing one produces no effect. Probe quality, not statistical significance, predicts causal relevance. Behaviourally, pushback destroys three to five times more correct answers than it repairs at 1B and reaches parity by 7B, falsifying our own pre-registered prediction, and a sign-reversing crossover between pushback types survives an order of magnitude of scale in Qwen and holds at 8B in Llama, with marginalisation over five paraphrases per type. We additionally quantify five measurement hazards, including a numerical-precision effect that changes roughly one episode label in ten.

title: A Common Language for Dynamic Graphs: Interaction Tokenization Enables Foundation Models
summary: Dynamic graphs capture evolving interactions in Web systems, including online communication, user engagement, and recommendation. Graph foundation models aim to reuse predictive capabilities across networks, but extending this capability to dynamic graphs faces two challenges. First, node identities are graph-specific, and similar interaction patterns can appear at different temporal and activity scales, making histories difficult to represent consistently across networks. Second, the predictive roles of historical patterns vary across interaction dynamics, limiting transfer from a narrow range of training processes. In this paper, we show that a common interaction language, combined with learning across diverse interaction processes, offers a basis for dynamic graph foundation modeling. We propose CL-DGFM, a Common Language Dynamic Graph Foundation Model for temporal link prediction. Its Dynamic Interaction Tokenizer encodes interaction memory, historical connectivity, and ordered destination transitions into calibrated tabular inputs, making dynamic histories accessible to existing predictors without an additional trainable graph encoder. Its Dynamic Interaction Prior trains a pretrained tabular foundation predictor across diverse synthetic dynamics. Labeled historical context guides prediction, with a Contextual Value Adapter modulating attention values. The model transfers to real graphs without target-graph parameter updates. Experiments on TGB and TGB-Seq demonstrate competitive performance. Further comparisons show that the common language supports basic machine learning and neural models, and enables direct use of frozen tabular foundation models on dynamic graphs.

title: A Cross-Domain Matrix Engine for Signal Processing and Deep Neural Net Inference
summary: Matrix multiplication dominates both PHY signal processing and Deep Neural Network (DNN) inference, yet these domains place opposing demands on the matrix engine. Signal processing requires low-latency execution of relatively small matrix operations, whereas DNN inference, particularly at large batch sizes, prioritizes high throughput and energy efficiency for large matrix multiplications. While offering efficient memory access profile, a Systolic Array (SA) adds fill and drain delays per matrix. Those can be amortized for large matrices but not for small matrices. Conversely, a tensor unit completes the kernel in few cycles but would require repeated reads of same operand tiles over large matrices. This makes SA too slow for signal processing and tensor too inefficient for AI. We show that this need not be a choice between systolic and tensor structuring of Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) units. We propose a single engine that operates primarily as a SA and, through low-cost reconfiguration, transforms into a tensor-style engine on a per-operation basis. MUXes create both the spatial reduction adder tree and temporal reduction accumulators from the existing MACs and registers within the systolic array. The proposed reconfigurable SA simulated using modified SCALESim simulator, verified on an Zynq 702 FPGA and synthesized using ASAP 7nm FinFET library. SCALE-Sim simulations shows up to 7.5x lower latency for small complex value PHY kernels. Even on DNN workloads, it achieves up to 1.65x speedups over vanilla SA execution with trivial increase of memory accesses, retaining the systolic array's memory access advantage. Synthesis results estimate reconfigurable fabric costs only 8% power and 13.6% area overheads.

title: A Fine-Grained Hierarchy and Benchmark for State Tracking in Language Models
summary: Theoretical limitations of transformers on state tracking---the ability to track information about entities or variables over long contexts---have motivated new recurrent language modeling (LM) architectures such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN). These architectures have, in particular, been benchmarked against the $S_5$ word problem, a theoretically hard state-tracking task that captures abilities such as code evaluation under arbitrary variable assignment. It, however, remains open whether other, simpler forms of state tracking might both be more relevant in practice and already explain observed differences between these architectures. We propose evaluating state tracking using a hierarchy of word problems with four increasing levels of difficulty: r-trivial, corresponding to immutable assignment to variables in programming; aperiodic, where assignments are mutable; soluble, where assignments are self-referential; and general finite state tracking. Theoretically, we show that the class of problems transformers are thought to length-generalize on does not even contain all aperiodic state tracking. On the other hand, we prove that GDN with positive eigenvalues expresses all aperiodic problems, and the regular languages recognized by certain transformers are precisely all soluble ones, thus providing a fine-grained picture of state tracking capabilities of various architectures. Taking these ideas to practice, we construct StateBench, a 4-tier long-horizon state-tracking benchmark. Our systematic direct training experiments across architectures largely align with theoretical expectation, albeit with interesting observations at very large scale length-generalization. Additionally, we also evaluate pretrained models---both open hybrid and closed frontier ones---on StateBench, finding that none of them robustly solves even soluble state tracking, suggesting a direction for future improvement.

title: A Geometry-Informed Neural Operator surrogate of LISFLOOD-FP for rapid pluvial-fluvial flood forecasting: the case of Forlì, Italy
summary: Physically based two-dimensional hydraulic models are too slow for real-time inundation forecasting and large ensembles. We present a time-dependent geometry-informed neural operator (GINO) surrogate of LISFLOOD-FP for the municipality of Forlì (Italy), severely affected by the May 2023 Emilia-Romagna floods. The surrogate is designed for an operational setting in which only river stage gauges and rain gauges are available. A reproducible pipeline turns public regional observations into a physically based training set: each river inflow is driven by the first stage gauge downstream of it through a calibrated water-surface boundary condition, and rain enters as SCS-CN effective rainfall. The surrogate is an autoregressive GINO trained on 216 simulations of 24 observed events with scaled forcing. It predicts volume-conserving polygon-mean depths on an exposure-based Voronoi mesh of 659 nodes, with a 20 min step over 72 h. The surrogate is tested on 38 independent observed events that it never saw during training. On these events it reaches a critical success index (CSI) of 0.934 at 0.05m and 0.844 at 0.3 m, a depth RMSE of 0.008m and an $R^2$ of 0.984 for maximum-depth maps. On one NVIDIA A10G GPU a 72-h forecast takes 1.7 s instead of 55 s with LISFLOOD-FP, and a 50-member ensemble, computed in a single batched rollout, takes 6.2 s instead of about 46 min, which makes probabilistic flood forecasting practical. These results show that neural-operator surrogates can deliver accurate pluvial-fluvial flood forecasts driven by river stage for operational early warning.

title: A Human-Verified AI Workflow for Annotating Environmental Sound Data
summary: Large-scale annotation of environmental sound recordings presents significant challenges under time and resource constraints, particularly when sound categories are imbalanced and only part of a dataset has been labeled. This paper describes the development and evaluation of a human-AI workflow used during annotation of the Kenya Forest Sounds Dataset (KFSD), using a project-stage working collection of 7,531 audio recordings across 21 categories. We investigated zero-shot classification, a feature-based ensemble, and a fine-tuned Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST). The fine-tuned AST achieved 89.36% accuracy, 85.98% precision, 89.24% recall, and 87.58% F1 on held-out test data for binary classification of Person talking. Because this result remained below the predefined 95% threshold for autonomous annotation, model predictions were used as suggestions and subjected to human verification. Of the 5,026 initially unlabeled recordings, 2,337 were routed to a speech-verification queue and 2,689 remained for ordinary manual annotation. The verifier reviewed all 2,337 machine-labeled files and detected zero false positives, yielding 100% verification accuracy. The observed average verification time was approximately 4.2 seconds per file. At an average rate of 35 seconds per file for manual annotation, the hybrid workflow reduced work on the remaining queue from approximately 48.9 to 28.9 person-hours, saving about 20.0 hours (41%). The study documents the model-selection process, provenance-aware file organization, verification procedure, observed errors, practical limitations, and opportunities for extending AI assistance beyond one category.

title: A Hybrid Visitor Prediction Framework using Interpretable Temporal features, Integrating IQR and Anomaly Detection in Lakes in Nebraska
summary: For effective resource management, infrastructure planning, and sustainable tourism, it is really important to predict accurate visitors. This paper estimates the daily visitation of Nebraska lakes using spatial, basic temporal, and interpretable temporal features. Moreover, we evaluate the base models with multiple metrics. Using the best three models, our method will ensemble hybrid models and choose the best hybrid technique. Further, we investigate the impact of lag features and how the models work with different outlier detection techniques such as Interquartile Range (IQR) and anomaly detection. The models are evaluated using regression metrics (MAE, MSE, RMSE, MAPE, and R2). Experiment results show that, after removing anomalies, MAE, MSE, RMSE, and MAPE are reduced. Adding lag features also shows some positive effects on the results. Moreover, anomaly detection techniques perform better than IQR in improving performance while preserving data. The reported anomaly-based cross-validation results favored the voting ensemble over the compared base models on the evaluated metrics. In anomaly-based cross-validation, VOTE improved prediction errors compared with MLP (256,128,64); improvements varied in the single-split comparison. Specifically, the hybrid model reduced MAE by 9.82%, MSE by 3.12%, RMSE by 1.76%, and MAPE by 6.77%. In the reported cross-validation comparison, the best anomaly-based hybrid model had lower MAE, MSE, RMSE, and MAPE than the best IQR-based hybrid model by 9.81%, 34.30%, 18.99%, and 0.66%, respectively.

title: A Living Leaderboard for Graph Machine Learning
summary: Graph machine learning benchmarking results are scattered across papers that use quite different sets of datasets and baseline methods, making it difficult to tell whether a reported gain reflects architectural progress or merely an outdated comparison or weakly tuned baseline. We introduce a living, graph-learning-specific leaderboard that organizes reported results by dataset, putting new results into context. As of 15 October 2026 our LLM-based extraction pipeline extracted 27,723 eligible results across 111 datasets from 885 peer-reviewed papers. Our analysis of these results quantifies concerns about graph-learning benchmarking: legacy datasets are still actively used and many result tables contain baseline results that are drastically lower than those already available in the literature, e.g. 45% Amazon-ratings tables and 37% for Peptides-struct. The leaderboard allows to quickly compare new results against compatible prior results, aiming to improve the overall quality of graph learning benchmarking.

title: A Novel Federated Learning Framework for Defending Against Gradient Inversion Attacks
summary: Federated Learning (FL) offers a paradigm for collaborative machine learning model training among clients, preserving data privacy by avoiding direct data sharing. However, the gradient information exchanged in FL has been shown to be vulnerable to Gradient Inversion Attacks (GIA), which can reconstruct sensitive user data. To counter these threats, various privacy-enhancing technologies like Secure Multi-party Computing (SMC), Homomorphic Encryption (HE), and Differential Privacy (DP) have been integrated into FL. While effective, these methods often introduce significant trade-offs between privacy and model utility. By revisiting the key to privacy exposure in FL under GIA, which lies in the frequent sharing of model gradients that contain private data, we take a new perspective by designing a novel privacy-preserving FL framework that effectively ``breaks the direct connection'' between the shared parameters and the local private data to defend against GIA. Our proposed framework, HyperFL++, leverages hypernetworks to generate local model parameters, where only the hypernetwork parameters are aggregated by the server. To ensure practicality, HyperFL++ incorporates a Row-wise Kronecker Decomposition (RKD) to mitigate the memory and communication overhead from the hypernetwork. Comprehensive theoretical analysis and extensive experiments validate our method's effectiveness in protecting data privacy while maintaining high model utility. Our code is available at https://github.com/Pengxin-Guo/HyperFL/tree/hyperfl%2B%2B.

title: A Parameter-Free Best-of-Both-Worlds Policy for Queueing Bandits
summary: We study online channel scheduling for a single queue served by $K$ channels under bandit feedback. We propose a simple best-of-both-worlds policy that explores when the queue is empty. During busy periods, it selects the empirical best channel while the prescribed conditions hold and, if any condition is violated, switches to a robust bandit policy to clear the queue. For arbitrary arrivals and services determined by an oblivious adversary, our policy achieves $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K L_T})$ worst-case queue length regret with high probability, where $L_T$ is the longest busy-period length. This result improves the previous $T^{3/4}$ dependence and matches the worst-case lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Under bounded i.i.d. stochastic models with a unique best stabilizing channel, we show that the cumulative queue length regret converges to a finite problem-dependent constant, and further establish the logarithmic expected worst-case queue length regret bound.

title: A Scientific Claim Stability Framework for Evaluating MRI Morphometry Pipelines
summary: MRI morphometry pipelines are often evaluated by measurement agreement or downstream accuracy, yet their scientific value depends on the conclusions they support. Two pipelines can produce similar feature-level results yet support different conclusions about aging, cognitive decline, or neurodegeneration.
